newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble little changed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Rouble little changed in quiet trade.

text.p: The rouble was little changed in quiet Monday trading, with banks reluctant to arbitrage in the absence of big-scale client orders, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Jun 9 midday Jun 9 early Jun 6 close
"There are plenty of funds, both roubles and dollars. No clients are seen, while arbitrage moves were very low," Rossiisky Kredit Bank dealer Dmitry Tyurnin said.
But dealers said rouble demand was seen higher on Tuesday ahead of Wednesday's sales of Treasury bills.
The Finance Ministry will auction 9.00 trillion roubles of 105-day GKO discount Treasury bills 5.50 trillion roubles of 364-day bills on June 11.
